The Delgado’s difference

A local business.
A family commitment.

Delgado’s Construction is a local, family-owned business built on honesty, hard work, and quality craftsmanship. We take pride in every job, big or small, and treat your home like our own.

From roofing and siding to plumbing, HVAC, framing, and interior and exterior renovations, we’re here to help bring your plans to life.

Before we get started

A few helpful answers.

Do you work on commercial properties?

Yes. We discuss residential and commercial roofing, repairs and renovation projects. Contact us with your property and scope.

What should I send for an estimate?

Your project location, the work you need done, preferred timing and any photos or ideas are a good starting point. Send photos by email or text.

How do I pay for my project?

Select “Pay now” to open our Square checkout. Enter your agreed deposit or project balance and identify the project. You can also pay using the link in your Square invoice.

How do I use the 5% discount?

Complete the five-hit nail challenge, then include HAMMER5 when requesting your estimate. The code is included automatically in the estimate request after you unlock it.
